alt: Redesigned sloped cedar roof on a modern home, exterior view
prompt: Wide exterior photograph of a residential home with a steeply sloped cedar shingle roof. The roofline is clean and well-proportioned, the cedar shingles are a warm honey-brown with natural grain variation. Golden hour or overcast daylight. Sky visible above. Architectural photography style, no people.

alt: Close-up of cedar shingle roofing material showing natural grain
prompt: Close-up macro photograph of cedar wood shingles on a sloped roof. Natural grain texture, warm brown and grey tones from weathering, slight texture variation between shingles. Soft diffused natural light. No people, no distracting elements.

alt: Side-by-side before and after comparison of a sloped cedar roof redesign
prompt: A split-image or wide side-by-side photo showing the same house before and after a cedar roof redesign. Left side: the original roof with older or plain geometry. Right side: the redesigned roof with improved roofline, cleaner aesthetics, and potentially a dormer or expanded eave. Exterior architectural photography, daylight, no people.

alt: Exterior view of a redesigned cedar roof with clean roofline
prompt: Exterior photograph of a residential building featuring a newly redesigned sloped cedar roof. Sharp, clean roofline, warm cedar tones, well-maintained shingles. Architectural photography style, clear daylight or overcast sky, no people.

alt: Interior of a newly enclosed upper floor created by a roof redesign
prompt: Interior photograph of a bright, newly enclosed room under a sloped roof. Exposed or finished ceiling following the roofline, natural light from a window or skylight, clean finishes. The space reads as a usable floor plate: bedroom, loft, or living area. Architectural interior photography style, no people.
